name: xxmi-debug
description: Codex integration for live Mod debugging and control of a running XXMI/3DMigoto instance through the standalone MCP bridge.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect and control running XXMI Mods
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to a running XXMI/3DMigoto instance for status, logs, frame analysis, live D3D11 context and draw probes, Mod runtime variables, bounded delta comparison, and config or shader reloads.
defaultPrompt: Inspect the running XXMI instance and recent Mod errors.
